claim: At peak LR 0.0006, the original 26.16M confirmation reduces arithmetic mean held-out PPL by 3.66482023398%, with all three seed pairs improving (Appendix A).
kind: original medium confirmation retained in Appendix A
limits: The holdout was fresh for this original confirmation and was subsequently reused for the 0.0003 comparison; report the two rates separately.

claim: At 2.33M with frozen LR .0048, V-only reduces fresh-holdout mean PPL by 2.03409468944%, five of five seed pairs.
limits: A fixed recipe selected using prior dev work; not an optimally tuned comparison; no cross-study pooling.

claim: Two selected four-layer nonlinear-projection candidates fail to match the six-layer baseline; mean PPL worsens 7.043054% and 6.820978%.
limits: This parameter allocation and initialization recipe only; same-depth V-only success does not reverse this result.

claim: Q-only SiLU worsens reused-dev mean PPL by 1.607848%; all-QKV SiLU improves 0.208029% with mixed directions and conditional interval crossing zero.
limits: No K-only arm; no equivalence test; no universal ranking of nonlinear Q/K/V.

claim: The combined small-model four-LR grid selects .0024 for both core arms; V-only mean dev PPL is 3.079144% lower at that LR.
limits: Same three seeds; supplement reuses 24 earlier trajectories; this is not a second independent replication.

claim: The two initial-moment controls underperform raw V-only at both tested LRs on all three paired seeds.
limits: Controls tested two LRs versus four for core arms; per-layer scalar moments matched only at initialization reference inputs; does not identify a unique causal mechanism.

claim: Medium raw full-context forward and training-step time ratios are 1.00700324093 and 1.01143326815.
limits: No controlled temperature, clock-frequency, or power trajectory; no claim about intrinsic latency, energy, isolated efficiency, or autoregressive decoding.

claim: The historical A–F/M bundle contains 133 scientific trajectories, 6063104 optimizer updates and 12417236992 sampled target exposures.
limits: Historical bundle only; excludes the later value-gate grid, 0.0003 medium confirmation, and G2 comparison. These trajectories are not independent seed replicates.

claim: The original 0.0006 medium NLLs, seed intervals, conditional bootstrap and cost aggregates can be recomputed without a GPU; newer cohorts have separate verifiers.
limits: Does not reproduce original model training, verify the full private execution archive, or independently establish contamination absence.

claim: At peak LR 0.0003, mean held-out PPL is 20.23339927033736 for baseline and 19.74786263081141 for GatedV, a 2.399679030887103% reduction across three improving seed pairs (Table 3).
kind: main medium-model comparison after development learning-rate selection
limits: Same three seeds and held-out windows as the original 0.0006 confirmation; not a newly sealed independent test.

claim: The original value-gate archive contains 19 development endpoints across five variants. At LR 0.0003, GatedV has PPL 20.061850777667633. Table 7 additionally includes three headwise G2 endpoints in their own evidence bundle.
limits: Seed 20270201; the additional four 0.00001 endpoints are excluded from the shared three-rate comparison.

claim: Switching linear and SiLU value transformations at inference increases held-out PPL for each of the six fixed medium-model checkpoints (Appendix B).
limits: Reuses the 0.0003 checkpoints and held-out set; does not uniquely separate training dynamics from inference-function effects.

claim: Headwise G2 has development PPL 21.568209346343224, 20.630306490469465, and 21.188993835008787 at peak learning rates 0.0006, 0.0003, and 0.0001. At 0.0003, GatedV PPL is 2.755439978870111% lower than G2 (Table 7).
